text:
carla: heads-up — we got a customer ask to push full runtime metrics out of their VPC to their Splunk/S3 stack. needs: agent (onprem), TLS+mutual auth, KMS-wrapped audit hooks, and minimal firewall rules.
ben: ok. are they pulling or do we push from the agent?
carla: customer wants push (agent -> our ingest endpoint) because their network team prefers outbound-only.
olga: outbound-only is doable but we need a short handshake to exchange mTLS certs and a per-tenant token. they want audit logs to hit their KMS for envelope encryption too.
maria: to clarify: they want the agent to encrypt payloads with their KMS key, then we forward encrypted blobs to their S3 (or they want us to forward to our collector and we relay?).
jess: product note — they prefer us to be a dumb relay (we don't store plaintext), but will accept us pushing to their collector if we can show audit provenance.
ben: technical paths: (A) agent -> customer S3 directly (agent needs AWS creds, egress to 443), (B) agent -> our collector endpoint (we forward to customer S3) — option B gives us better metrics visibility but raises compliance questions.
carla: compliance says we can support B if we implement envelope encryption with customer's KMS and record audit hooks. basically we never touch plaintext.
telemetry-bot: new ticket #INF-789 created: implement envelope-enc flow + per-tenant certificate rotation. Assigned to @ben and @olga.
olga: firewall constraints: customer only allows outbound to specific IP ranges and must whitelist our collector IPs. can we provide a small set of stable IPs?
ben: yes — we'll serve collector behind a small FIP pool and publish the list. need SLA on changelog though.
maria: dashboards requirement: ops wants a dashboard that shows per-tenant: bytes sent, batch size distribution, encrypt/decrypt success, agent version, TLS handshake failures, and queue depth. Also a tag for "routing_decision" (hosted/dedicated/relay) so console can show where metrics were routed.
jess: add UX: in Redwood Console we need a downloadable audit bundle (signed) per transfer window. Ops wants an index: timestamps, envelope key id, hash, and agent id.
ben: implementation details — agent will expose metrics locally in Prometheus format; the agent will also emit an encrypted payload to /v1/exports using mTLS + JWT signed with the customer KMS-wrapped signing key. sample curl for dev:
```
curl --cert agent.crt --key agent.key https://collector.example.com/v1/exports \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <tenant-jwt>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" \
  --data-binary @payload.enc
```
olga: handshake flow idea: agent calls /v1/handshake, collector responds with per-session ephemeral cert and accepted cipher list; agent then uses that cert for uploads. saves long-lived private keys on the agent store.
carla: we need to add metrics fields at runtime side: cache_kv_hits, cache_kv_misses, prefix_cache_size, batching_latency_p95, tokens_per_request_p50, route_reason. those are critical for model routing dashboards.
maria: can we also attach per-request model_variant and quantization_profile labels? We need that for cost vs quality correlation.
ben: labels ok but cardinality risk. suggest we roll up into model_family label and emit quant_profile as low/med/high. avoid raw model hashes.
telemetry-bot: note — new metric names proposed: ri_agent_exports_total, ri_export_encrypt_errors_total, ri_export_handshake_failures_total, ri_export_queue_depth_gauge, ri_route_decision_counter{reason}.
jess: UX request — in Console add an "Export Handshake" page where customers can see the last 30 days of handshake events, cert fingerprints, and download the audit bundle.
carla: open question: do we do envelope encryption with customer KMS (preferred) or rely on agent-provided symmetric keys?
olga: customer KMS is preferred for security, but agent must call STS-like assume-role to get temporary wrap keys. offline/onprem customers may not allow STS calls. fallback: local HSM or bring-your-own-key file.
ben: we need a short PRD decision matrix in the ticket: (1) cloud customers -> KMS wrap, (2) VPC with internet -> KMS via STS, (3) air-gapped -> HSM/file key. I'll draft.
maria: for dashboards — Grafana panels should be backed by Prometheus/remote write we ingest. if we route via our collector and we never decrypt, we still need the agent to push metrics to our metrics pipeline (separate channel) OR the agent exposes a prometheus endpoint we scrape (but scraping inbound from our side may require inbound access).
carla: outbound-only constraints mean scrape is not possible. so agent must push metrics to our metrics relay (OTLP/gateway) on 443. that relay will accept plaintext metrics (only metrics) while export payloads are encrypted blobs. ensures observability.
ben: implement two streams: 1) /v1/metrics (OTLP) — plaintext small metrics; 2) /v1/exports — encrypted payload. both use mTLS and token.
jess: UX: onboarding flow must show the exact IPs to whitelist, example firewall rules and a test vector. also a "test upload" button in Console that triggers a handshake and returns status.
olga: sample firewall allowlist snippet for customers:
```
# allow outbound egress to Redwood collector
iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp -d 203.0.113.10 --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
# allow DNS
iptables -A OUTPUT -p udp --dport 53 -j ACCEPT
```
carla: security: we must include a signed audit header from agent for each export: X-RI-Audit: base64(json {agent_id, ts, key_id, sig}). Store these in our audit index but never store content. customer KMS key id recorded.
ben: timeline: I'll pick up the agent changes (handshake + KMS wrap) — estimate 2 weeks dev + 1 week integration tests. olga will own deployment infra and IP allocation. maria/jess will own Console/dashboard and UX.
telemetry-bot: INF-789 status: in-progress. components: agent-change (ben), collector-handshake (olga), console-audit-ui (jess), dashboards (maria).
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline: agent-change branch passed CI, staging deploy started.
carla: thanks everyone. next sync: 3pm Wed to validate sample encrypted export and the metrics dashboard queries. please add any blockers to INF-789. :thumbsup:
ben: adding the PR link in the ticket now.
maria: I'll sketch dashboard panels and attach them to the ticket by EOD.
jess: I'll draft the console onboarding copy with firewall examples.
olga: will confirm public IP list and update the changelog policy (how we rotate).
carla: perfect — closing thread for now.
